## Cite MOFography

This is the original MOFography paper(s), please cite it if you use MOFography in your work:

```{bib}
@article{mofography,
    title={Advanced High-Throughput Characterization of Nanoporous Materials using Pore Graphs},
    author={Gopalan, Arun and Shi, Kaihang and Zheng, Chao and Azadpour, Behnam and Sarkisov, Lev},
    journal={ChemRxiv},
    year={2026},
    doi={10.26434/chemrxiv.15011793/v1},
    url={https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv.15011793/v1}
}

```
